sn46.33:1.1: Pañcime bhikkhave jātarūpassa upakkilesā || Yehi upakkilesehi upakkiliṭṭham jātarūpaṃ na ceva mudu hoti || na ca kammaniyaṃ na ca pabhassaram pabhāṅgu ca na ca sammā upeti kammāya || ||
sn46.33:1.3: Ayo bhikkhave jātarūpassa upakkileso || yena upakkilesena upakkiliṭṭhaṃ jātarūpaṃ na ceva mudu hoti na ca kammaniyaṃ na ca pabhassaram pabhaṅgu ca na ca sammā upeti kammāya || || 4.
sn46.33:1.4: Loham bhikkhave jātarūpassa upakkileso || yena upakkilesena uppakkiliṭṭham jātarūpaṃ || la-pe || || 5.
sn46.33:1.7: Sajjhum bhikkhave jātarūpassa upakkileso yena upakkilesena uppakkiliṭṭham jātarūpam na ceva mudu hoti na ca kammaniyaṃ na ca pabhassaram pabhaṅgu ca na ca sammā upeti kammāya || || 8.
sn46.33:1.8: Ime kho bhikkhave pañca jātarūpassa uppakkilesā yehi upakkilesehi uppakkiliṭṭhaṃ jātarūpaṃ na ceva mudu hoti || na ca kammaniyaṃ na ca pabhassaram pabhaṅgu ca na ca sammā upeti kammāya || ||
sn46.33:2.1: Evam eva kho bhikkhave pañcime cittassa upakkilesā || || yehi upakkilesehi upakkiliṭṭhaṃ cittaṃ na ceva mudu hoti || na ca kammaniyaṃ na ca pabhassaram pabhaṅgu ca na ca sammā samādhiyati āsavānaṃ khayāya || ||
sn46.33:2.3: Kāmacchando bhikkhave cittassa upakkileso || yena upakkilesena upakkiliṭṭhaṃ cittaṃ na ceva mudu hoti na ca kammaniyam na ca pabhassaraṃ pabhaṅgu ca na ca sammā sammādhiyati āsavānaṃ khayāya || || 10--13. || la || 14.
sn46.33:2.4: Ime kho bhikkhave pañca cittassa upakkilesā || yehi upakkilesehi upakkiliṭṭhaṃ cittam na ceva mudu hoti na ca kammaniyaṃ na ca pabhassaram pabhaṅgu ca na ca sammā samādhiyati āsavānaṃ khayāyā
